verified: Sellas announced that galinpepimut-S met the primary endpoint of a Phase 3 trial in advanced AML by reducing the risk of death by 41% versus standard treatment, as reported by STAT.
unconfirmed: the size of the survival benefit in absolute terms (median overall survival), the hazard ratio's confidence interval, progression-free survival, and safety/tolerability data — all undisclosed; the result rests on the company's own announcement with no peer-reviewed paper or independent analysis, and STAT's September column had predicted the trial would fail.

verified: Sellas 公司称，galinpepimut-S 在晚期 AML 三期试验中达到主要终点，死亡风险较标准治疗降低 41%（依据是公司公告，而非同行评审论文）。
unconfirmed: 疗效数据背后的风险比及其置信区间、中位总生存期、安全性细节，以及该结果是否足以支持向监管机构提交上市申请；这些均仅有公司说法，报道本身也因付费墙未提供完整数据。

titles.en: Sellas says galinpepimut-S cut death risk 41% in Phase 3 AML trial
titles.zh: Sellas 血癌免疫疗法三期试验达标，死亡风险降 41%
